title: Ivory architectural poster
prompt: Create an exceptionally polished 16:9 marketplace campaign thumbnail for Salat Times, a native Omarchy prayer-time plugin. Exact text: 'SALAT TIMES'; supporting text 'Prayer times for Omarchy'; small feature line 'Worldwide • Hijri • Qibla'. Art directed, strong focal point and legible title at small size, intentional composition. No emerald or green, no clock ring, no UI screenshots or imaginary app screens. No extra marketing claims, no watermark. This is one of three design options for user selection. Direction 2: A premium Swiss editorial architectural poster on warm ivory, huge black typographic title SALAT TIMES in two confident lines, a dramatic cropped terracotta-and-sandstone mihrab wall on the right with sharp diagonal afternoon shadow, architectural model photography, beautiful granular materials and deep sculptural relief. Bold saffron and burnt-orange accent, charcoal ink and ivory ground, no gold-on-green. Asymmetric paper-like editorial restraint, striking near/far scale and exceptional typography. Clean dark subtitle, small aligned feature line. No empty stock-photo filler.
